cross_pipeline_bridge_candidates.rationale: Same author Daniel M. Gross. The 2005 essay 'rhetorical ontology' and the 2017 'situated emotion' framework share methodological DNA; expect concept-continuity edges on the rhetoric-as-ontology axis. NOTE per user directive: no full author-evolution deliverable produced — HR-01 was an edited-collection intro, not a load-bearing monograph statement. Light bridge edges only.

Rickert thanked in Acknowledgments. Rickert's 'ambient' framework and Gross's 'uncomfortable situation' / hostile-environment framework both elaborate situatedness beyond classical rhetorical situation. Strong concept overlap.

The book's broader subfield (Emotion Studies in rhetoric) ultimately descends from Aristotle Rhetoric II's emotion-as-cognition framework. Expect occasional Aristotle-pipeline bridges where Gross invokes classical rhetoric.
